name: Military Plaza
summary: Military Plaza is a community shopping center located on Southwest Military Drive in San Antonio, serving local residents with convenient access to retail stores and services. With over 2,000 reviews and a 4.3-star rating, it has established itself as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination for the southwest side of the city.
demographics: Military Plaza serves a diverse, working-class to middle-income demographic on San Antonio's southwest side, with a strong Hispanic population that comprises the majority of shoppers. The trade area attracts families and value-conscious consumers seeking convenient neighborhood shopping, with typical household incomes ranging from $30,000 to $60,000 annually. Visitors are primarily local residents within a 3-5 mile radius who make frequent trips for everyday needs, groceries, and services, with shopping patterns emphasizing practicality and affordability over luxury experiences.
description: Military Plaza is a community shopping center strategically located at 715 Southwest Military Drive in San Antonio, Texas, serving as a vital retail hub for the city's southwest neighborhoods. Named after the historic Military Plaza in downtown San Antonio, this center provides convenient access to essential shopping, dining, and services for local residents along one of the area's major commercial corridors. The center maintains strong community ties and caters to the everyday needs of San Antonio families with a practical mix of retailers and service providers. With a solid 4.3-star rating from over 2,000 Google reviews, Military Plaza has established itself as a reliable neighborhood destination where locals can accomplish their shopping needs efficiently. Open daily from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM, the center offers extended hours that accommodate working families and busy schedules throughout the week.
